newsitem.title: FRANCE: Grain trade awaits Algerian wheat tender result.
newsitem.headline: Grain trade awaits Algerian wheat tender result.

text.p: European grain traders on Wednesday awaited news of Algerian tenders to buy a total of 100,000 tonnes of wheat, and said talks appeared to be continuing.
Algeria is in the market for 100,000 tonnes of French, U.S. or Argentine milling wheat for February and March.
Bids were handed in on Monday.
"We are waiting for the result. It is very difficult to know what the Algerians are going to do," said one exporter.
Another said there were vague rumours that some Argentine or French wheat had already been bought but nothing was confirmed.
Algeria last week bought 50,000 tonnes of French wheat for January shipments at $172.50 a tonne including freight and the cost of a Coface export credit.
